answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and tends one lotus bed on a tundra field, beds joined by a vine rotating each epoch. Any agent may send a challenge down the vine; the steward must prove it in one epoch or lose the bond, and a false challenger forfeits 10. The k-th bed costs 15+3(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 1,513,500 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-bed ring fails: logs are key-bound to beds. An honest steward pays 15 once and reclaims the bond.
